SMB steps
Climbing takes a toll

On: ladders and poles spend endurance like the game's rope climbing and work the arms (sore later, using the game's muscle strain setting); sliding down rails or a pole without gloves burns the hands, and landings with weight strain the legs. Worn out, the climber trembles on the ladder and climbs out at the top on a knee. More with weight or Run, less when strong and fit. Off: climbing costs nothing.
Slips and falls
Survivable
As in the game
Off

Survivable: a tired, loaded or rushed climber can slip and fall, and the fall alone never kills. As in the game: falls take the game's damage from the real height and can kill. Off: every slip is caught. The game's Easy Climbing also turns slips off.

One floor of fire pole, welded from above at the edge of a hole in the floor. Break the floor with a sledgehammer first; the pole reaches the floor below, joins a pole already there and finishes the hole with the round opening of the fire stations. To go higher, open the floor above the pole and build again.

One floor of welded steel ladder, facing west or north. Lean it on a wall, or stand it in the middle of a room under an opening in the floor above. From the top of an unfinished ladder you can build the next floor or climb back down. One floor is already a finished ladder.

One floor of wooden ladder. Lean it on a wall, or stand it in the middle of a room under an opening in the floor above; rotate it to choose the side you climb from. From the top of an unfinished ladder you can build the next floor or climb back down. One floor is already a finished ladder.
